data.job_description:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

The role

The role holder will be the Team leader, leading the end‑to‑end forecasting process and Management Reporting support within the GBS team, with in-depth knowledge of the Tagetik Financial Planning tool and its critical role in the company's S&OP process. Responsibilities include ensuring data quality and data hygiene in the forecasting and management reporting processes, partnering with Country Finance business partners to resolve pricing issues, identifying and addressing any discrepancies in forecasted numbers, govern the overall process run by the D&A team and ensure end to end completeness and sign off from countries, regions and BG.

What You'll Be Responsible For

• Coordinating the forecasting cycles, ensuring timeliness, data completeness, and accuracy.
• Ensuring full data hygiene across the forecasting process: from live data (foundational data) to final submitted forecast.
• Resolving all missing price and cost data in a timely manner and proactively following up with relevant stakeholders.
• Identifying and correcting the list price and transfer price issues; and maintaining a clear overview of missing or inconsistent pricing.
• Safeguarding the performance and accuracy of the Tagetik Financial Planning tool, ensuring effective data modelling for forecasting.
• Running the forecasting cycle, analysing results, and delivering actionable financial insights.
• Maintaining and overseeing Tagetik interfaces with D&A and other relevant systems to ensure data flows correctly.
• Supporting countries, regional teams, and central leadership with manual adjustments and leadership overlays within the Tagetik Financial Planning tool.
• Reporting GMVA for the forecasting cycle.
• Supporting budget monitoring, variance analysis, and cost‑control activities across functions.
• Executing reconciliations (FIPA), supporting MEC activities, and contributing to compliant financial reporting.
• Preparing P&L reports, COGS/Sales reconciliations, GPVA analysis, and weekly/monthly sales flashes.
• Maintaining documentation, supporting audits, and assisting in process optimisation initiatives.

We're Looking For Someone Who

• Has experience in Business Planning (forecasting) and the S&OP process (Sales & Operations Planning) and an understanding of Finance’s role within it and can operate confidently in high paced environment.
• Brings strong skills in Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge, IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy, Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes.
• Thinks end-to-end and takes ownerships for results
• Is comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving organization
• Values collaboration, clarity and low-ego ways of working

What You'll Get

Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes

• Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
• Flexible ways of working
• Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
• Time off to rest and recharge
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities
• Specific benefits vary by location

#TMICC

Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

• Roles with real accountability and visible impact
• Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
• Continuous learning and development as the business grows
• Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

data.job_description:
About Us

Ecolab (NYSE: ECL) is a global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions, trusted by millions of customers worldwide. With $16B in annual sales, 48,000 associates, and operations across 170+ countries, we deliver science‑based innovations and data‑driven insights that improve sustainability, enhance food safety, and optimize water and energy use across industries including food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality, and manufacturing.

Role Overview

We are looking for a "Senior Financial Analyst II" to join our Finance team in Pune. In this role, you will drive efficiency by simplifying and standardizing FP&A processes, ensuring accurate reporting, and delivering actionable insights to business leaders. You will partner with cross‑functional teams to support strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting, while also managing compliance and revenue recognition.

Must Have skills:

1) End to end Financial Data Analysis – Dashboard creation using (Power BI/Tableau/ any tool)

2) Profit & Loss (P&L) management and analysis

3) Reporting – Variance analysis, cost impact analysis, and sales analysis

4) Budgeting & Forecasting – Plan vs. actuals, forecast vs. plans

5) Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

Important Note: We are seeking candidates preferably from manufacturing companies only. Profiles from IT or GCC setups will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities
• Business Partnering with division leaders (end-to-end).
• Build Financial Models for business deals analyze risks and propose mitigation plans.
• Conduct moderate to complex Business & Financial Analysis.
• Support Strategic Planning, ad hoc reporting, and analysis for internal/external stakeholders.
• Coordinate closely with Sales and Leadership teams on Budgeting and Monthly Forecasting for business units.
• Perform Cost Analysis, product pricing, rebate calculations, and contract compliance checks.
• Draft and renew agreements for customers/distributors; collaborate with Regional Teams (IMEA) and Global Teams (US & Europe).
• Handle Revenue Recognition, sales reconciliation, and BI sales adjustments at month-end.
• Manage cost guarantee accruals for Food & Beverage customers.
• Hands-on with EPM & HFM; perform publishing and ad hoc analysis on Oracle Essbase.
• Work on rebate provisions, prepaid advances schedules, and yearly Sales Planning.
• Develop scorecards, track district/SBU performance, and manage monthly reporting requirements.
• Support internal/statutory audits, resolving auditor queries.

Requisites
• 8+ years’ experience in FP&A and business partnering.
• Prior P&L Responsibility of at least $5Mn in a global organization preferred.
• MBA from a reputed institute strongly preferred.
• Basic knowledge of Power BI or other digital tools is an advantage.
• Strong team player with hands-on problem-solving skills and inclusive orientation.
• Proven success in multi-divisional, matrix organizations with strong Customer Focus.
• Excellent proficiency in English (verbal and written); additional languages a plus.
• Strong Executive Presence with presentation, interpersonal, and consultative skills.
• Self-motivated, high-energy individual who thrives in growth and change, with potential to grow beyond current role.

Ecolab is seeking a Senior FP&A Transformation Leader to lead the modernization of FP&A insights and reporting Globally by enabling scalable, interactive, and AI-enabled analytics.

What’s in it For You:

• Join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits.

• Make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

• Be supported by an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.

• Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments.

What You Will Do:

• This role is based in Pune, India (hybrid). You will partner across Finance, Technology, Data, and Analytics to transform how the business consumes FP&A insights—moving from static reporting to interactive, self-service, and AI-enabled decision support system

Where You’ll Make a Difference

• Lead end-to-end transformation of FP&A dashboards—evolving static reporting into interactive, AI-enabled insights that support decision-making.

• Standardization across region, FP&A reporting using standard Tools Technology stack

• Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to translate business needs into scalable analytics products and AI-driven solutions.

• Define, standardize, and govern finance logic, KPIs, and insight narratives embedded in dashboards to drive consistent outcomes.

• Design intuitive self-service experiences (Copilot-like finance insights) that deliver fast, relevant, decision-ready information.

• Serve as the finance approval authority for dashboard designs, analytics models, and automated insights—ensuring alignment to finance governance and business priorities.

• Drive stakeholder adoption and value realization of analytics solutions across global finance and business partners.

• Demonstrate ownership and accountability with a sustained focus on business impact, value creation, and continuous improvement.

Key Stakeholders & Operating Model

• Partner with Divisional Finance leadership and FP&A teams to translate planning, forecasting, and performance needs into dashboard roadmaps and prioritized releases.

• Work closely with Global BI / Data & Analytics teams (e.g., MAP 2.0 / FP&A datasets) to ensure scalable design, data quality, and performance.

• Collaborate with Finance Systems and enterprise data/platform teams to align to governance, security access, refresh SLAs, and change management processes.

• Engage with functional and adjacent finance partners (e.g., CP&A, Supply Chain Finance, Commercial Finance) to standardize KPIs and definitions across reporting suites.

Success Measures (First 6–12 Months)

• Deliver a prioritized transformation roadmap and release cadence for NA FP&A dashboards (with clear scope, owners, milestones, and sign-offs).

• Improve usability and stakeholder adoption of the reporting suite (measured through active users, repeat usage, and stakeholder feedback from UX sessions).

• Strengthen trust in data and definitions by establishing standard KPI logic, tie-out routines, and governance documentation for key dashboards.

• Reduce manual effort and cycle time for recurring FP&A insights (e.g., month-end and forecast cycles) through automation and self-serve analytics.

• Launch at least 2–3 high-value enhancements (e.g., open orders / MTG projection views, daily movement “walks”, persona-based insight narratives) with measurable business impact.

What Makes You the Right Fit

• 12–14+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, and/or Finance Transformation roles within complex or matrixed environments.

• Proven experience leading dashboard, analytics, or reporting transformations, including modernization of FP&A insights.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, performance management, and enterprise-level financial metrics.

• Hands-on exposure to BI tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI or similar) and familiarity with AI-enabled reporting solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable business insights and storylines.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences.

How Would You Stand Out?

• Experience operating in a global or multi-regional context with an understanding of standard finance governance, access controls, and sign-off processes.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align Finance, Technology, and business teams on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery timelines.

• Experience with modern data and BI stacks (e.g., Power BI, semantic models, SQL; familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Azure and/or Snowflake).

• A product mindset—comfortable running discovery, defining personas and user journeys, and delivering iterative releases (Agile) with measurable outcomes.

Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field (MBA preferred).

• Experience leading finance transformation programs, including process, reporting, and/or analytics modernization.

• Proficiency applying automation and AI concepts to strengthen analytics capability (e.g., driver-based insights, forecasting enablement, narrative generation).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.

Tooling & Technical Preferences:

• Strong Power BI capability (data modeling, DAX fundamentals, performance optimization, and dashboard UX best practices).

• Data scientist having worked in Global Projects including FP&A transformation

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Azure services and/or Snowflake) and an understanding of refresh SLAs and data quality controls.

• Understanding of security and governance concepts (role-based access, personas, finance definition control, change management, and production deployment discipline).

• Understanding of AI products that can be scaled at an Enterprise level for FP&A Analytics

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. data.job_title: Staff Accountant - Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting
data.job_description:
Job Description

As a Staff Accountant in Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting at NIQ, you will play a critical role in supporting the company’s external financial reporting and technical accounting functions. You will be instrumental in assisting with the preparation of consolidated financial statements and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings in accordance with U.S. GAAP and consolidated statutory financial statements in accordance with IFRS, assisting with maintaining compliance with SOX internal controls and supporting complex accounting areas.

Responsibilities –

Reporting:

• Assist in the preparation of draft SEC filings including Form’s10-Q, 10-K and 8-K reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements
• Assist in the preparation of supporting documentation for disclosures included in external reporting documents
• Support the tie-out validation procedures and maintain supporting documentation on other externally released financial information including, but not limited to, annual proxy, investor presentations, earnings releases, etc
• Support ongoing collaboration cross-functionally with Investor Relations, Treasury, International subsidiaries and internal/external auditors to gather and validate financial data
• Assist in the preparation of legal entity financial statements, including IFRS statutory reporting
• Assist in the preparation of monthly stock compensation expense calculations
• Support the preparation of schedules and other documentation in accordance with the Company's internal controls, quarterly financial close process, disclosure checklist and the quarterly and annual SEC reporting calendar
• Support account analysis, footnote tie-outs and supporting schedules
• Assist in the external audit process by providing timely and accurate supporting documentation
• Support ongoing SOX compliance by executing and documenting internal controls over financial reporting
• Participate in key reporting initiatives and cross-functional projects as an accounting resource including implementation of new or modified financial reporting requirements or other accounting implementations
• Assist in the collection, analysis, preparation and submission of governmental survey information on an ad hoc basis
• Provide assistance/support to other areas within the accounting/finance group and other ad hoc project work, as requested
Technical Accounting:

• Provide assistance in technical accounting processes in complex areas including:• Adoption of new accounting standards
• Acquisition and disposal transactions
• Debt transactions

• Support technical accountants and contribute to ad hoc projects as needed

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU (Role)

A successful Staff Accountant will achieve a balanced coordination of priorities and seamless execution of meeting targeted deadlines particularly in peak financial reporting periods. Intellectually curious and exhibits excellent analytical aptitude.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or a related field
• Certified Accountant designation (CA / CPA / ACCA) or actively pursuing professional licensure
• Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in public accounting (Big 4 preferred) or within a medium to large international organization
• Strong interpersonal skills with excellent verbal and written communication skills; capable of engaging professionally across all levels
• Detail oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and analytical thinking
• Familiarity with statutory reporting, technical accounting and applicable standards such as US GAAP and IFRS is advantageous
• Experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP and OneStream
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with intermediate to advanced Excel capabilities

Additional Information

Our Benefits

• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)
NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://www.nielseniq.com/global/en/ai-safety-policies.

About NIQ

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Job Overview:

DSIJ is looking for a highly experienced and result-oriented Senior Equity Research Manager to lead and strengthen our equity research and advisory function. The role requires deep expertise in the Indian equity markets, strong research capabilities, and leadership skills to manage a team of analysts while delivering high-quality stock research and actionable investment recommendations and monitoring content writing assignments.
Key Responsibilities:

1. Equity Research & Stock Analysis:

• Conduct in-depth fundamental analysis of listed Indian companies across sectors, including financial modeling, valuation, and earnings analysis.

• Perform detailed financial analysis, valuation analysis and scenario analysis.

• Interpret financial statements, earnings reports, management commentary, corporate actions, industry developments and regulatory developments.

• Prepare comprehensive equity research reports, investment notes, and stock recommendations.

• Monitor portfolio stocks and update views based on market developments.

• Co-ordinating and monitoring content writing assignments such as daily market commentary, analysing stock market trends, key indices, and economic events, breaking news and updates in the financial markets.

• Create in-depth articles that simplify complex financial concepts, educational content for the readers.

2. Advisory & Investment Strategy:

• Generate actionable investment ideas aligned with DSIJs advisory philosophy.

• Develop medium- to long-term investment strategies based on macroeconomic and sector trends.

• Support portfolio construction and performance review activities.

• Develop and implement investment themes and strategies based on

• macroeconomic, sector-specific, or market-driven insights.

3. Market & Sector Coverage:

• Track market trends, indices, and sector developments.

• Publish market outlooks, sector reports, and thematic investment ideas.

4. Team Leadership & Mentoring:

• Lead and mentor a team of equity research analysts.

• Review research outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance,

• Conduct training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

• Ensure the team delivers high-quality, accurate, and timely research reports.

• Foster a collaborative environment within the team, encouraging knowledge sharing and professional growth.

• Provide constructive feedback and support to analysts to enhance their research skills and output.

5. Compliance & Process Adherence:

• Ensure compliance with SEBI regulations and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with compliance teams for disclosures and audits.

Skills & Qualifications:

• MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, or equivalent.

• 7-10 years of experience in equity research or investment advisory.

• Strong expertise in financial modeling, valuation, and Indian equity markets.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Location: Pune (Kalyani Nagar)
Employment Type: Full-time
